diff.description: Unified diff (dryRun or when changes present)

destination.description: Destination path for the failed move

includeHash.description: Include SHA-256 hash of the content

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading (single-file mode only; mutually exclusive with line params)

length.description: Number of bytes to read (single-file mode only; used with offset; reads to EOF if omitted)

path.description: Resolved absolute path to the file

resourceUri.description: Full content URI in resource store

searchPattern.description: Text or regex to find (RE2: no lookahead/lookbehind/backrefs when isRegex=true)

dryRun.description: Preview changes without writing (default false = apply changes)

pattern.description: File glob filter (default: all text files)

searchPattern.description: Text or regex to search for (RE2: no lookahead/lookbehind/backrefs when isRegex=true)

contextLines.description: Lines of context before AND after each match (symmetric; overridden by contextBefore/contextAfter)

contextBefore.description: Lines of context before each match (overrides contextLines for before)

contextAfter.description: Lines of context after each match (overrides contextLines for after)

fuzzy.description: Approximate string matching (Levenshtein-based, ≤25% char difference). Incompatible with isRegex.

maxResults.description: Max matches to return per page
